key_differences_summary: APY is a long-term PENSION scheme (retirement savings) suited for unorganised workers aged 18-40 who are not income-tax payers. PMSBY is a short-term ACCIDENT INSURANCE scheme available to all bank account holders aged 18-70 at minimal cost (Rs. 20/year). APY guarantees monthly income in old age; PMSBY protects against accidental death/disability. They serve different purposes and can be used together.
recommendation: Choose APY if: You are aged 18-40, not a tax-payer, and want guaranteed monthly pension after age 60. Choose PMSBY if: You are aged 18-70 and want affordable accident insurance protection regardless of tax status. Both can be taken together as they serve different needs. Consult your bank or visit the official portals for personalized guidance. This comparison is AI-assisted and not official government advice.
